title: Blueprint
body:
"A blueprint that holds schematic data, used for the schematic fabricator! Has a bunch of color options you can cycle through. Has a limit of 500 schematics!"

Description

The Blueprint can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $5,500.

Used in the Blueprints Fabricator, which can also be found at The Oak Depot.

Can store data for builds to sell to players.


Special thanks to Noodles (@Creeper249yt) for creating this page!
